children: Zhipu, a domestic large-model developer, has opened an official flagship store on Tmall and is selling products including Coding Plan packages on September 2. According to ChainCatcher, the store currently offers personal Lite, Pro, and Max subscription tiers that can be purchased monthly, quarterly, or annually. Token purchases may also be completed on the e-commerce platform in the future.

title: Zhipu Opens Official Tmall Flagship Store to Sell Coding Plan Packages
